20261125-chemistry-g02-1.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Âmatière so a dissous na ngû na âmélange (1) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261125-chemistry-g02-2.title: Âmatière so a dissous na ngû na âmélange (2)
20261125-chemistry-g02-2.summary: Ndâli ti nyen sûkâ a dissous na yâ ngû ti wâ a kiri kozo na yâ ngû ti froid?
20261125-chemistry-g02-2.principle: Tongana tempêrature ti ngû ayeke ngangu, âmolécule ti ngû a tï na âgrain ti sûkâ ngangu mingi, ni la dissolution a ga kozo.
20261125-chemistry-g02-2.example: Tongana tempêrature ayeke ngangu, âmolécule a mû ngangu mingi.
20261125-chemistry-g02-2.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Âmatière so a dissous na ngû na âmélange (2) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261125-chemistry-g03-1.title: Âtrois état ti matière: solide, liquide na gaz (1)
20261125-chemistry-g03-1.summary: Matière ti état wa so fason ti lo a changer nzoni na vase so a zi lo na yâ ni, me volume ti lo a changer pëpe?
20261125-chemistry-g03-1.principle: Liquide, âmolécule ti ni a lï na solide pëpe, ni la fason ti lo a changer nzoni na vase, me attraction ti âmolécule a ngbâ, ni la volume ti lo a ngbâ.
20261125-chemistry-g03-1.example: Bâ tongana a zi ngû wala lait na yâ mbeni kopo.
20261125-chemistry-g03-1.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Âtrois état ti matière: solide, liquide na gaz (1) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261125-chemistry-g03-2.title: Âtrois état ti matière: solide, liquide na gaz (2)
20261125-chemistry-g03-2.summary: A zi ngû na yâ oko seringue, a zi air na yâ mbeni ôko seringue, a kpa na doigt ndö ti piston, na a mû piston ngangu. Tënë wa a ga?
20261125-chemistry-g03-2.principle: Gaz (air) ayeke na distance mingi na popo ti âmolécule, ni la a compresser nzoni. Liquide (ngû) âmolécule ti lo ayeke mbâ awe, ni la a compresser pëpe.
20261125-chemistry-g03-2.example: Âmolécule ti gaz ayeke mingi na ndo ti mbâ.
20261125-chemistry-g03-2.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Âtrois état ti matière: solide, liquide na gaz (2) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261125-chemistry-g04-1.title: Évaporation, ébullition, condensation na changement ti volume ti glace (1)
20261125-chemistry-g04-1.summary: A zi mbeni canette ti boisson so a sigigi na réfrigérateur na ndo ti table. Na pekô ti mbeni kete ngoi, kete ngû a kpe na ndö ti canette. Ngû so a sigigi na ndo wa?
20261125-chemistry-g04-1.principle: Vapeur ti ngû ti gaz so ayeke na yâ air a tï na ndö ti canette ti froid, a zi wâ ti lo, na a ga kete ngû ti liquide. A iri ni «condensation (liquéfaction)».
20261125-chemistry-g04-1.example: Vapeur ti ngû ayeke ngbâ na yâ air, a bâ ni pëpe.
20261125-chemistry-g04-1.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Évaporation, ébullition, condensation na changement ti volume ti glace (1) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261125-chemistry-g04-2.title: Évaporation, ébullition, condensation na changement ti volume ti glace (2)
20261125-chemistry-g04-2.summary: Tongana ngû ti liquide a ga glace ti solide, poids na volume ti ni a changer tongana nyen?
20261125-chemistry-g04-2.principle: Tongana ngû a ga glace, masse (poids) a ngbâ, me âmolécule a sâra cristal hexagonal na liaison hydrogène so ayeke na ndo mingi, ni la volume a kpe lani 10%.
20261125-chemistry-g04-2.example: Tongana ngû a ga glace, nombre ti âmolécule a changer pëpe.
20261125-chemistry-g04-2.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Évaporation, ébullition, condensation na changement ti volume ti glace (2) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261125-chemistry-g05-1.title: Soluté, solvant, solution na concentration (1)
20261125-chemistry-g05-1.summary: A zi 50 g ti sûkâ na yâ 200 g ti ngû, a dissous kue. Na yâ ngû ti sûkâ so, «solvant», «soluté» na «solution» ayeke nyen?
20261125-chemistry-g05-1.principle: Ngû so a dissous ni ayeke «solvant», sûkâ so a dissous ayeke «soluté», na mélange clair so a sâra na ôse kue a iri ni «solution».
20261125-chemistry-g05-1.example: Liquide so a dissous = solvant, matière so a dissous = soluté, mélange = solution.
20261125-chemistry-g05-1.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Soluté, solvant, solution na concentration (1) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261125-chemistry-g05-2.title: Soluté, solvant, solution na concentration (2)
20261125-chemistry-g05-2.summary: A ye ti bâ kua ti solution ti ngû ti sêl na yâ béchér. Tënë wa so ayeke nzoni na ndo ti solution, mélange homogène?
20261125-chemistry-g05-2.principle: Solution pur (mélange homogène) ayeke na âparticule ti soluté so a lï nzoni na popo ti âmolécule ti solvant. Ni la a lï pëpe na pekô ti ngoi, na concentration ayeke mbâ na ndo kue.
20261125-chemistry-g05-2.example: Solution ayeke mélange homogène so âparticule a lï nzoni.
20261125-chemistry-g05-2.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Soluté, solvant, solution na concentration (2) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261125-chemistry-g06-1.title: Acide, base na âtrois condition ti combustion (1)
20261125-chemistry-g06-1.summary: A zi âsolution ti sioni na yâ indicateur ti chou rouge. Solution A a ga rouge, solution B a ga bleu na a ga jaune. Tënë wa so ayeke nzoni ti ôse solution?
20261125-chemistry-g06-1.principle: Indicateur ti chou rouge a ga rouge na yâ solution acide, na a ga bleu, vert na jaune na yâ solution basique.
20261125-chemistry-g06-1.example: Indicateur naturel ti chou rouge ayeke na pigment anthocyane.
20261125-chemistry-g06-1.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Acide, base na âtrois condition ti combustion (1) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261125-chemistry-g06-2.title: Acide, base na âtrois condition ti combustion (2)
20261125-chemistry-g06-2.summary: A zi acide chlorhydrique so a kete ngangu wala vinaigre na ndö ti coquille ti œuf wala marbre (carbonate de calcium). Bulle a sigigi. A zi gaz so na yâ eau de chaux. Tënë wa a ga?
20261125-chemistry-g06-2.principle: Carbonate de calcium ($\text{CaCO}_3$) na acide a sâra gaz dioxyde ti carbone ($\text{CO}_2$). Dioxyde ti carbone a sâra réaction na eau de chaux ($\text{Ca(OH)}_2$) ti sâra précipité blanc ti carbonate de calcium, ni la eau a ga trouble.
20261125-chemistry-g06-2.example: Carbonate na acide a sâra gaz ti dioxyde ti carbone (CO₂).
20261125-chemistry-g06-2.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Acide, base na âtrois condition ti combustion (2) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261125-chemistry-g07-1.title: Loi ti Boyle, loi ti Charles na changement ti état (1)
20261125-chemistry-g07-1.summary: Ndâli ti nyen «pression ti gaz» so a mä na mur ti récipient fermé so gaz ayeke na yâ ni?
20261125-chemistry-g07-1.principle: Pression ti gaz a gä na force par unité de surface so âparticule ti gaz a sâra tongana a tï ngbâ na mur ti yâ ti récipient na mouvement désordonné.
20261125-chemistry-g07-1.example: Âmolécule ti gaz a gä na vitesse ti ngangu mingi.
20261125-chemistry-g07-1.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Loi ti Boyle, loi ti Charles na changement ti état (1) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261125-chemistry-g07-2.title: Loi ti Boyle, loi ti Charles na changement ti état (2)
20261125-chemistry-g07-2.summary: Na tempêrature ti ngbâ, volume ti gaz ayeke 60 mL na pression 1 atm. A zi pression na 3 atm. Na loi ti Boyle, volume ti gaz so ayeke nyen?
20261125-chemistry-g07-2.principle: Na loi ti Boyle, tongana tempêrature ayeke mbâ, $P_1 V_1 = P_2 V_2$ a ngbâ. Ni la $1\text{ atm} \times 60\text{ mL} = 3\text{ atm} \times V_2 \implies V_2 = 20\text{ mL}$.
20261125-chemistry-g07-2.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Loi ti Boyle, loi ti Charles na changement ti état (2) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261125-chemistry-g08-1.title: Élément, atome, ion na réaction ti précipité (1)
20261125-chemistry-g08-1.summary: Atome so a sâra na noyau na électron ayeke neutre na électricité. Ndâli ti nyen?
20261125-chemistry-g08-1.principle: Atome ayeke neutre na électricité ndâli ti charge (+) ti âproton ti noyau na charge (−) ti âélectron so a tourner ayeke mbâ.
20261125-chemistry-g08-1.example: Noyau ayeke na charge (+) ndâli ti proton.
20261125-chemistry-g08-1.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Élément, atome, ion na réaction ti précipité (1) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261125-chemistry-g08-2.title: Élément, atome, ion na réaction ti précipité (2)
20261125-chemistry-g08-2.summary: Tënë wa so ayeke nzoni na ndo ti formation ti «ion», tongana atome neutre a zi wala a wara électron na a ga charge?
20261125-chemistry-g08-2.principle: Atome a zi électron ti couche ti dehors ti ga cation (métal), wala a wara électron ti sâra anion (non-métal) so a ye règle ti l'octet.
20261125-chemistry-g08-2.example: Sodium (Na) a zi 1 électron ti ga Na⁺.
20261125-chemistry-g08-2.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Élément, atome, ion na réaction ti précipité (2) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261125-chemistry-g09-1.title: Conservation ti masse, proportion ti âélément, réaction exothermique na endothermique (1)
20261125-chemistry-g09-1.summary: Ndali tî nyen loi tî conservation tî masse ayeke tâ tongana changement tî chimie asara fini?
20261125-chemistry-g09-1.principle: Tongana réaction tî chimie asara fini, lege tî atome tî mû ndo ayeke changer ge, ti sara ye so ayeke fini; sorte na nombre tî atome ayeke ngbâ so pëpe a yeke kanga wala a yeke sigigi pëpe, so ndali tî so masse kûê ayeke changer pëpe.
20261125-chemistry-g09-1.example: Gbu li tî mo na loi tî Lavoisier tî conservation tî masse.
20261125-chemistry-g09-1.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Conservation ti masse, proportion ti âélément, réaction exothermique na endothermique (1) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261125-chemistry-g09-2.title: Conservation ti masse, proportion ti âélément, réaction exothermique na endothermique (2)
20261125-chemistry-g09-2.summary: A sara mbeni expérience tî tene a zia poudre tî cuivre na yâ creuset na a yô ni na yâ ngu ti sara oxyde tî cuivre(Ⅱ). Tongana cuivre 4 g asara réaction kûê, oxyde tî cuivre(Ⅱ) 5 g asigigi. Masse tî oxygène so asara ngbanga na rapport tî masse tî cuivre na oxygène ayeke tongana nyen?
20261125-chemistry-g09-2.principle: Masse tî oxygène so asara réaction ayeke $5\text{ g} - 4\text{ g} = 1\text{ g}$. Na loi tî proportion constante, rapport tî masse tî cuivre na oxygène so ayeke na yâ oxyde tî cuivre(Ⅱ) ayeke tongaso kûê: $4 : 1$.
20261125-chemistry-g09-2.example: Loi tî conservation tî masse: (cuivre 4 g) + (oxygène ? g) = oxyde tî cuivre 5 g
20261125-chemistry-g09-2.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Conservation ti masse, proportion ti âélément, réaction exothermique na endothermique (2) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261125-chemistry-g10-1.title: Liaison ionique, liaison covalente na oxydoréduction (1)
20261125-chemistry-g10-1.summary: Résultat tî expérience so a sara tî comparer conductivité électrique tî substance A (chlorure tî sodium) na substance B (sucre), tâ nzoni ayeke nyen?
20261125-chemistry-g10-1.principle: Chlorure tî sodium so ayeke substance ionique ayô na yâ ngû ti sara cation na anion, so ndali tî so électricité ague na yâ solution, me sucre so ayeke substance covalente ayô tongana molécule, porteur tî charge ayeke pëpe, so ndali tî so électricité ague pëpe.
20261125-chemistry-g10-1.example: Substance ionique (NaCl) tongana ayô na yâ ngû, a ayeke ionise ti sara ion so ayeke gue na lege ti ni.
20261125-chemistry-g10-1.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Liaison ionique, liaison covalente na oxydoréduction (1) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261125-chemistry-g10-2.title: Liaison ionique, liaison covalente na oxydoréduction (2)
20261125-chemistry-g10-2.summary: Tongana a zia solution tî hydroxyde tî sodium (NaOH) kete kete na yâ acide chlorhydrique dilué (HCl) tî quantité so a hon, résultat tî mesure tî changement tî nombre tî ion na yâ solution na température ayeke tongana nyen?
20261125-chemistry-g10-2.principle: Tongana réaction tî neutralisation asara fini, chaleur tî neutralisation alë, so ndali tî so température tî solution ayeke kota mingi na point tî neutralisation so réaction asara fini. Ion chlorure ($\text{Cl}^-$) ayeke ion spectateur so asara réaction pëpe, so ndali tî so nombre tî ni ayeke ngbâ oko.
20261125-chemistry-g10-2.example: Tongana réaction tî neutralisation (H⁺ + OH⁻ → H₂O) asara fini, chaleur tî neutralisation alë.
20261125-chemistry-g10-2.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Liaison ionique, liaison covalente na oxydoréduction (2) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261125-chemistry-g11-1.title: Mole (1)
20261125-chemistry-g11-1.summary: Na 0℃ na 1 atmosphère, nombre tî mole tî molécule tî méthane na nombre total tî mole tî atome tî hydrogène (H) so ayeke na yâ 11.2 L tî gaz méthane (CH₄, masse moléculaire 16) ayeke tongana nyen?
20261125-chemistry-g11-1.principle: Nombre tî mole tî molécule tî méthane ayeke $n = \frac{11.2\text{ L}}{22.4\text{ L/mol}} = 0.5\text{ mol}$. Na yâ $1$ molécule tî méthane ayeke atome tî hydrogène $4$, nombre total tî mole tî atome tî hydrogène ayeke $0.5 \times 4 = 2.0\text{ mol}$.
20261125-chemistry-g11-1.example: Na 0℃ na 1 atmosphère, 1 mol tî gaz = 22.4 L.
20261125-chemistry-g11-1.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Mole (1) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261125-chemistry-g11-2.title: Mole (2)
20261125-chemistry-g11-2.summary: Tongana a ye ti sara 500 mL tî solution standard tî hydroxyde tî sodium (NaOH, masse formulaire 40) 0.1 M, masse tî NaOH solide pur so a ye ayeke nyen?
20261125-chemistry-g11-2.principle: Nombre tî mole tî $\text{NaOH}$ so a ye ayeke $n = M \times V = 0.1\text{ mol/L} \times 0.5\text{ L} = 0.05\text{ mol}$. Masse so a ye ayeke $w = n \times M_w = 0.05\text{ mol} \times 40\text{ g/mol} = 2.0\text{ g}$.
20261125-chemistry-g11-2.example: Molarité M = nombre tî mole (mol) / volume tî solution (L)
20261125-chemistry-g11-2.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Mole (2) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261125-chemistry-g12-1.title: Vitesse ti réaction, principe ti Le Chatelier na pile chimique (1)
20261125-chemistry-g12-1.summary: Tongana a zia 'catalyseur positif (Positive Catalyst)' na yâ réaction tî chimie, ye wa asara fini? Sï lege so ayeke tâ.
20261125-chemistry-g12-1.principle: Catalyseur positif amû mbeni lege tî réaction fini so énergie d'activation tî ni ayeke kete, na asara so constante tî vitesse tî réaction directe na réaction inverse aga kota na pourcentage oko. Lo changer enthalpie tî réaction ($\Delta H$) na constante d'équilibre ($K$) pëpe ngbii.
20261125-chemistry-g12-1.example: Catalyseur ayeke changer pëpe différence tî énergie na yâ substance tî kozo na produit tî pekoni (ΔH).
20261125-chemistry-g12-1.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Vitesse ti réaction, principe ti Le Chatelier na pile chimique (1) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261125-chemistry-g12-2.title: Vitesse ti réaction, principe ti Le Chatelier na pile chimique (2)
20261125-chemistry-g12-2.summary: Na réaction 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), na méthode tî vitesse initiale, tongana a zia [O₂] ngbâ oko na a sara [NO] aga 2 fois, vitesse aga 4 fois, na tongana a zia [NO] ngbâ oko na a sara [O₂] aga 2 fois, vitesse aga 2 fois. Loi tî vitesse tî réaction so na ordre total tî réaction so ayeke nyen?
20261125-chemistry-g12-2.principle: Tongana $[\text{NO}]$ aga $2$ fois vitesse aga $4$ fois, so ndali tî so $m=2$, na tongana $[\text{O}_2]$ aga $2$ fois vitesse aga $2$ fois, so ndali tî so $n=1$. Loi tî vitesse ayeke $v = k[\text{NO}]^2[\text{O}_2]$, na ordre total tî réaction ayeke $2 + 1 = 3$.
20261125-chemistry-g12-2.actionItem: Analyze the principles of Vitesse ti réaction, principe ti Le Chatelier na pile chimique (2) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.

20261119-english-g02-1.title: 'Two tickets, please.' ayeke na ndo wa? Jugement so information alingbi wala pëpe
20261119-english-g02-1.summary:
Mo mä ye so ôko homme na ôko employé tî tickets atene. Ala atene ape so ndo ni ayeke wa.

Man: Two tickets, please.
Clerk: Here you are. The show starts at 7:00.
20261119-english-g02-1.principle: Ticket na show ayeke anzo so a sâra kua na ni na ndo mingi, tongana cinéma wala salle tî concert. Ayeke ngangu tî décider ôko na lignes use gï.

english-g02-1.title: 'Two tickets, please.' ayeke na ndo wa? Jugement so information alingbi wala pëpe

20261119-english-g04-1.title: Note ti Mama na ntangu ti ngia ti Jisu
20261119-english-g04-1.summary:
Note so Mama azia na table (a gbu gi na texte, image ayeke pëpe):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Na pekoni ami ti lo Jisu atomba texte. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"
20261119-english-g04-1.principle: Piano class ayeke 4:00-4:30, ni la 4:15-4:30 akpa na ndö ti ti nde, na kpa trash na 5:00 asi na yâ ti 4:15-5:15. Kiri na ndo na 3:30 na dîner na 6:30 ayeke na gbe ti ntangu ti park.
20261119-english-g04-1.example: Zia ligne oko oko vene na ntangu ti park '4:15-5:15' oko oko, na bâ so ni asi kozo ti ni wala ni akomanse pekoni.
20261119-english-g04-1.actionItem: Sara comparaison ti plan mingi na note ti Mama na ntangu so ami afa, wara ndo so ala alingbi pëpe, na tene ôn-ën na anglais na fa ntangu ti nde.

20261119-english-g04-2.title: Fa ntangu ti promenade ti chien na ti devoir
20261119-english-g04-2.summary:
Note so Papa azia (a gbu gi na texte, image ayeke pëpe):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

Na gbe, gbu ntangu oko oko tongana 'minute mingi tongana nye pekoni ti 4:00 p.m.'. Na exemple, tongana mo komanse na 4:30, gbu 30, na tongana mo komanse na 5:15, gbu 75.
20261119-english-g04-2.principle: Devoir ayeke 5:00-6:00 na promenade ayeke 5:30-6:00, ni la tâche use akpa na ndö ti ti nde ti 5:30 tî 6:00. Promenade akomanse pekoni ti 5:00 na use asi kozo ti 6:30, ni la condition ti nde angbâ.
20261119-english-g04-2.example: Zia ntangu so a sara (na minute) na ntangu ti komanse ti tâche oko oko ti wara ntangu so ni asi.
20261119-english-g04-2.actionItem: Sara combinaison mingi ti nde ti ntangu ti promenade na ntangu ti devoir so asara condition kue ti note ti Papa.

20261119-english-g07-1.title: Ben ayeke ga na fête? Ti bâ sens ti ahide ti réponses ti lo
20261119-english-g07-1.summary:
Dialogue ti Jisu na Ben (a gbâ ni na texte gï, image ayeke pëpe):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.

Ben atene gï so lo alingbi ti ayeke fatigué, na na nzoroko lo atene lo ayeke vérifier na maman ti lo kozo. Ni la ye ayeke so a zia décision ti ni (ngoi) na ye ayeke so angbâ (permission ti maman ti lo), na ni a zia décision ti ni pëpe awe.
20261119-english-g07-1.example: Divisé tënë ti Ben na morceaux 4: 'soccer game,' 'party time,' 'tired,' na 'mom.'
20261119-english-g07-1.actionItem: Divisé réponses ti Ben na dialogue ligne na ligne, fa ndulu ti ye so a zia décision ti ni na ye so angbâ, na zia jugement na ndulu ti tene 'lo ayeke ga' wala 'lo ayeke ga pëpe'.

20261119-english-g10-1.title: E sû tongana nyen deux avis so ayeke na conflit na journal tî école?
20261119-english-g10-1.summary:
Mo ayeke na équipe éditoriale tî journal anglais tî école. Avis use na ndö tî festival ayeke nde na ôko na ôko.

School notice: "Festival: Friday, 4 p.m., in the gym. Free for all students."
Student council poster: "Festival: Friday, 5 p.m., in the gym. Tickets: 1,000 won."

Mo confirmer ape ngbii so ôko wa ayeke correct.
20261119-english-g10-1.principle: Tongana a confirmer ni ape, ye juste ayeke tî tene ye so sources use ôko ôko atene, na tene na lecteurs so a vérifier ni ngbii. Sï ôko mbage na tene ni, wala tene na azo tî ga ape na information ayeke ape, asara lecteurs aleurrer.
20261119-english-g10-1.example: Sara comparaison tî information so annonce ôko ôko amû na lecteurs na ye so ala vuko.
20261119-english-g10-1.actionItem: Sû tî lecteurs (élèves) mbeni texte so amû deux avis nde nde na lege juste, na tene ye so a confirmer ni ape na ye so lecteurs lingbi tî sara.

20261119-english-g10-2.title: Cas oko alingbi ti fa ndali ti tene 'ngbâ'?
20261119-english-g10-2.summary:
Ni ayeke ndo ti texte so a imprimer na journal ti ecole (nömörö ti ligne akomanse na 1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone.
20261119-english-g10-2.principle: Ligne 3 ayeke kpale. Tene so nömörö ayeke 'tâ' kiri ti 'student kue' na gi nömörö ti student oko so akiri (ligne 2) ayeke conclusion kota ahon preuve. Nömörö so akiri alingbi ti ayeke na ndali ti nde, tongana ngangu ti test wala bê-ti-mo. Ligne 4 amû ndali ti nde na nömörö (bruit, triche), ni la a lingbi ti bâ ni na tele ti ni na problème so. "Banned for everyone" na ligne 5 asi nga na conclusion so, me ndo so problème asi kozo ayeke ligne 3.
20261119-english-g10-2.example: Ti ligne oko oko, fa nde ti 'ye so ni atene' na 'ye so ni asi na conclusion'.
20261119-english-g10-2.actionItem: Na texte ti argument, wara ligne so preuve akpe bâ so nzoni pëpe, gbu sika ni tongana phrase so abâ nzoni mingi, na decide preuve wa a hunda ti sika.

20261119-english-g11-1.title: Instruction ti travail so ayeke clair pëpe: ye wa a lingbi ti hunda kozo?

Ni ayeke email so stagiaire Jiho awara ti chef d'équipe Ms. Han.

Hi Jiho,

Thanks,
Ms. Han

Faits so Jiho ahinga: Calendrier ti équipe afa rencontre na Aurora Co. na mardi na 10:00 na rencontre na Blue Pine Ltd. na jeudi na 14:00. Dossier partagé ayeke na fichiers ti résumé ti ventes ndulu ti juillet, août na septembre.

20261121-english-g01-1.title: Gi actions so alingbi na pancarte tî piscine ape
20261121-english-g01-1.summary:
Pancarte na entrée tî piscine (a sû ni na anzo gï, image ayeke ape):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = an adult)

Azo 4 ayeke ague na piscine.
Mina ayeke 7. Lo ga na maman tî lo, na lo ayeke na bonnet.
Jun ayeke 10. Lo ga seul, na lo ayeke na bonnet ape.
Tom ayeke 6. Lo ga na frère tî lo. Frère tî lo ayeke 9. Tom ayeke na bonnet.
Sue ayeke 11. Lo ague na pied na piscine seul, na lo ayeke na bonnet.
20261121-english-g01-1.principle: Jun ayeke na bonnet ape, ndali ni lo kpe règle 2. Tom ayeke kêtê ahon 8, me frère so aga na lo ayeke 9, ndali ni lo ayeke 'grown-up' ape, na Tom akpe règle 3. Mina aga na maman tî lo, na Sue ayeke 11, ndali ni ayeke nzoni so lo ague na lo ga seul.
20261121-english-g01-1.example: Sara tableau na âge tî zo ôko ôko, zo wa lo ga na lo, na bonnet, ôko ôko.
20261121-english-g01-1.actionItem: Sara correspondance tî règles ota so ayeke na pancarte na situation tî zo ôko ôko, sï cas so akpe règles, na tene ndali na anglais.

Maître atene na ndurû, "How are you today, Mina?"

Ami tî mo Jin atene, "Na anglais, tî tene na politesse ayeke nzoni ngbii kûê. Mo lingbi tî tene tongana so na zo kûê."
20261121-english-g02-2.principle: b na d aréponder na salut na demander nga na zo nde, ndali ni alingbi na maître. a ayeke décontracté mingi na c ayeke rude.
20261121-english-g02-2.example: Vérifier nde nde so réponse alingbi na question na so ayeke alingbi na maître.
20261121-english-g02-2.actionItem: Sï réponse so alingbi na salut tî maître, na fa mbeni cas so tene 'ayeke nzoni tî ayeke poli tî ngbii kûê' alingbi ape.

20261121-english-g03-1.title: Wara ngoi ti diko na programme ti Samedi ti Mina
20261121-english-g03-1.summary:
Programme ti Samedi ti Mina (a gbâ ni na texte gï, image ayeke pëpe):

10 a.m.: I can start my free time.
12 p.m. - 1 p.m.: Lunch
1 p.m. - 2 p.m.: Dance class
5 p.m.: Dinner. I must finish before dinner.

Mina aye ti diko livre ti heure 1. Lo kamata na heure même na asara ni na heure même.
20261121-english-g03-1.principle: Ngoi libre akamata na heure 10 ti matin, na 12 ti 14 ayeke plein na repas ti midi na danse. Activité oko ape ayeke na horaire ti 15 ti 16 na ti 16 ti 17, na ala asï ti ti si na repas ti nuit.
20261121-english-g03-1.example: Sara changement ti ngoi na programme na nombres ti 24 heures na sara bande ti temps.
20261121-english-g03-1.actionItem: Sara ngoi ti kozo ti diko ndulu so alingbi na conditions kue ti programme, na fa ndali ti nyen ngoi ti ambeni asara travail pëpe.

20261121-english-g03-2.title: Fa 'worry' na tene ni ape
20261121-english-g03-2.summary: Mo ye ti sara écrire mbeni scène so ami ti mo Mina ayeke na souci na yâ ti mbeni test. Texte so atene sentiment kâ kâ na texte so afa ni na aactions asï na lecteur na lege mbeni mbeni.
20261121-english-g03-2.principle: Na amains so ayeke froid na ti kaï horloge fois mingi, lecteur alingbi ti sara jeu ti nervosité. Ti bâiller na ti bâ na dehors ti fenêtre amû idée ti ennui, na ti sourire na ti sara écrire na ngoi kete amû idée ti tranquillité wala confiance.
20261121-english-g03-2.example: Na yâ ti chaque ti atextes ota, wara na sara écrire action wala change ti kâ ti Mina.
20261121-english-g03-2.actionItem: Sara mbeni kete texte so lecteur alingbi ti sara jeu ti sentiment gï na aactions na aindices ti kâ, na mot ti sentiment oko ape.

20261121-english-g04-1.title: Note ti Mama na ntangu ti ngia ti Jisu
20261121-english-g04-1.summary:
Note so Mama azia na table (a gbu gi na texte, image ayeke pëpe):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Na pekoni ami ti lo Jisu atomba texte. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"
20261121-english-g04-1.principle: Piano class ayeke 4:00-4:30, ni la 4:15-4:30 akpa na ndö ti ti nde, na kpa trash na 5:00 asi na yâ ti 4:15-5:15. Kiri na ndo na 3:30 na dîner na 6:30 ayeke na gbe ti ntangu ti park.
20261121-english-g04-1.example: Zia ligne oko oko vene na ntangu ti park '4:15-5:15' oko oko, na bâ so ni asi kozo ti ni wala ni akomanse pekoni.
20261121-english-g04-1.actionItem: Sara comparaison ti plan mingi na note ti Mama na ntangu so ami afa, wara ndo so ala alingbi pëpe, na tene ôn-ën na anglais na fa ntangu ti nde.

20261121-english-g04-2.title: Fa ntangu ti promenade ti chien na ti devoir
20261121-english-g04-2.summary:
Note so Papa azia (a gbu gi na texte, image ayeke pëpe):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

Na gbe, gbu ntangu oko oko tongana 'minute mingi tongana nye pekoni ti 4:00 p.m.'. Na exemple, tongana mo komanse na 4:30, gbu 30, na tongana mo komanse na 5:15, gbu 75.
20261121-english-g04-2.principle: Devoir ayeke 5:00-6:00 na promenade ayeke 5:30-6:00, ni la tâche use akpa na ndö ti ti nde ti 5:30 tî 6:00. Promenade akomanse pekoni ti 5:00 na use asi kozo ti 6:30, ni la condition ti nde angbâ.
20261121-english-g04-2.example: Zia ntangu so a sara (na minute) na ntangu ti komanse ti tâche oko oko ti wara ntangu so ni asi.
20261121-english-g04-2.actionItem: Sara combinaison mingi ti nde ti ntangu ti promenade na ntangu ti devoir so asara condition kue ti note ti Papa.

20261121-english-g05-1.title: Pensée ti mo asara changement tongana mo diko affiche
20261121-english-g05-1.summary: Jun ayeke membre ti Green Library pëpe. Ami ti lo Ara ayeke membre ti Green Library. Ala use ayeke diko affiche na ndo ti bibliothèque ligne oko oko.
20261121-english-g05-1.principle: Sara changement ti jugement ti mo ngoi oko oko so information ti affiche a fa ni na étapes, na sara question anglaise so avérifier information so ayeke na affiche pëpe.
20261121-english-g05-1.example: Kaï so phrase so ayeke fini ti ngoi so achange jugement ti kozo ti mo wala ape.
20261121-english-g05-1.actionItem: Sara changement ti jugement ti mo ngoi oko oko so information ti affiche a fa ni na étapes, na sara question anglaise so avérifier information so ayeke na affiche pëpe.

20261121-english-g05-2.title: 'Most popular' - texte asûtenu ni?
20261121-english-g05-2.summary:
Classe ti Mina ayeke na coin ti lecture na étagère ti livres.

Our class has a reading corner. There are 20 books on the shelf. Twelve of them are about animals. Four are about space, and four are story books. The teacher did not buy any new books this year.

Mina atene, "Animal books are the most popular in our class."
20261121-english-g05-2.principle: Texte atene gï nombre ti livres na étagère (livres ti animaux 12, na ambeni). Ni atene pëpe livres wa élèves adiko wala aprêter mingi, ni la e lingbi ti vérifier tënë 'most popular' pëpe.
20261121-english-g05-2.example: Bâ 'popular' afa nyen na tënë ti Mina, na gi phrase na texte so afa ni na mo.
20261121-english-g05-2.actionItem: Bâ so information ti nombres na texte asûtenu tënë (popular) wala pëpe, na sara question anglaise so alingbi ti vérifier tënë.

20261121-english-g06-1.title: Club ti livre ayeke succès? Ndoye jugement ti mo tongana preuve agä mingi
20261121-english-g06-1.summary: Club ti livre ti sika akomanse na ecole ti e. Professeur atene, "Club ayeke succès." Mo yeke wara preuve oko oko na mo yeke bâ na bê ti mo so tënë so ayeke tâ wala pëpe.
20261121-english-g06-1.principle: Tongana a zia data oko oko, ndoye jugement ti mo na ndö ti tënë 'club ti livre ayeke succès', na kobe na anglais na preuve use.
20261121-english-g06-1.example: Tri ye so data so mo na ni sika afa tâ na ye so mo hinga pëpe ngbâ.
20261121-english-g06-1.actionItem: Tongana a zia data oko oko, ndoye jugement ti mo na ndö ti tënë 'club ti livre ayeke succès', na kobe na anglais na preuve use.

20261121-english-g06-2.title: Sara tableaux tî gi cas so claim ayeke vrai
20261121-english-g06-2.summary: 20 élèves na yâ tî classe ôko ôko amû ôko vote tî activité na pekoni tî temps tî snack: football, art, wala musique. A fa votes tongana s (football), a (art), na m (musique).
20261121-english-g06-2.principle: 8 votes ayeke kota ahon art (6) na musique (6), ndali ni ayeke the most, na ayeke kêtê ahon 10 so ayeke moitié tî 20, ndali ni ayeke moitié ape. Ndali ni a ayeke correct.
20261121-english-g06-2.example: Ajouter 8, 6, na 6, gi moitié tî 20 élèves, na sara comparaison.
20261121-english-g06-2.actionItem: Sara tableaux mingi tî votes mo même so claim anglais 'ni awara votes mingi ahon, me ayeke moitié tî classe ape' ayeke vrai.

20261121-english-g07-1.title: Ben ayeke ga na fête? Ti bâ sens ti ahide ti réponses ti lo
20261121-english-g07-1.summary:
Dialogue ti Jisu na Ben (a gbâ ni na texte gï, image ayeke pëpe):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.
20261121-english-g07-1.principle: Match ti soccer ayeke na matin na fête ayeke na 4 p.m., ni la ngoi use asara chevauchement pëpe. Ben atene gï so lo alingbi ti ayeke fatigué, na na nzoroko lo atene lo ayeke vérifier na maman ti lo kozo. Ni la ye ayeke so a zia décision ti ni (ngoi) na ye ayeke so angbâ (permission ti maman ti lo), na ni a zia décision ti ni pëpe awe.
20261121-english-g07-1.example: Divisé tënë ti Ben na morceaux 4: 'soccer game,' 'party time,' 'tired,' na 'mom.'
20261121-english-g07-1.actionItem: Divisé réponses ti Ben na dialogue ligne na ligne, fa ndulu ti ye so a zia décision ti ni na ye so angbâ, na zia jugement na ndulu ti tene 'lo ayeke ga' wala 'lo ayeke ga pëpe'.

20261121-english-g07-2.title: 'That's fine.' afa tâ so ni ayeke nzoni?
20261121-english-g07-2.summary: Sam na Papa atene ti plans ti vendredi. A fa dialogue na morceaux ota. A gbâ ni na texte gï, image ayeke pëpe.
20261121-english-g07-2.principle: Tongana mo diko dialogue kete kete, zia jugement ti sentiments ti yâ ti zo so atene, na kiri sara jugement ti kozo ti mo tongana indice vandâ aga.
20261121-english-g07-2.example: Wara ton wala mot vandâ oko na morceau so.
20261121-english-g07-2.actionItem: Tongana mo diko dialogue kete kete, zia jugement ti sentiments ti yâ ti zo so atene, na kiri sara jugement ti kozo ti mo tongana indice vandâ aga.

20261121-english-g08-1.title: Réécrire claim so ague mingi na bibliothèque asara so scores aya
20261121-english-g08-1.summary: Mbeni écrivain tî blog aye tî sû ye so: 'Library visits make students' scores go up.' E vérifier phrase so na données.
20261121-english-g08-1.principle: Tongana données nouveau a fa ni, décider mbeni lâ so mo lingbi tî ayeke sûr ngbii tongana nyen na ndö tî claim, na réécrire phrase tî lï.
20261121-english-g08-1.example: Na étape ôko ôko, vérifier so information nouveau asoutenir jugement tî kozo wala asara so ni ayeke ngangu ape.
20261121-english-g08-1.actionItem: Tongana données nouveau a fa ni, décider mbeni lâ so mo lingbi tî ayeke sûr ngbii tongana nyen na ndö tî claim, na réécrire phrase tî lï.

20261121-english-g08-2.title: Sara sika ligne so nömörö ayeke sioni na blog ti nettoyage ti plage
20261121-english-g08-2.summary: Student oko na classe oko agbu post so na blog ti ecole. (Ni ayeke gi texte. Ligne oko oko ayeke na nömörö.)
20261121-english-g08-2.principle: Ligne 3 atene so ala abungbi sac 30 na heure ti kozo, na ligne 4 atene so total ayeke sac 18. Total alingbi ti ayeke kete ahon ye so a bungbi na heure ti kozo pëpe. Post so gi alingbi ti fa pëpe so ligne 3 wala ligne 4 ayeke sioni, ni la mo lingbi ti fa oko.
20261121-english-g08-2.example: Bungbi gi ligne so ayeke na nömörö na sara comparaison ti ala.
20261121-english-g08-2.actionItem: Wara phrase use ti nömörö na blog so alingbi pëpe na tele ti ala, na gbu sika ala ti alingbi na tënë so a bâ awe.

20261121-english-g09-1.title: Ye so a fä ape na 'e vo alunch 200 kete'
20261121-english-g09-1.summary:
A zia ni na tableau d'affichage na ndö ti cafétéria ti lekole.

"Na mois so, cafétéria avendre alunches 200 kete ti mois so akiri. Ni la aélèves aimer fini menu ape."
20261121-english-g09-1.principle: Ti ti kiri ti fait so aventes akete na 'ni alingbi na goût ape', aconditions ti ndo ti ni (nömörö ti aélèves, nömörö ti alâ ti lekole, na ti ndo ti ni) alingbi ti ayeke même. Tongana aélèves ayeke kete wala alâ ti lekole ayeke kete, aventes akete même na goût même.
20261121-english-g09-1.example: Kozo sara écrire na langue ti mo même nyen alingbi ti ayeke ngbanga ti "alunches so a vendre akete".
20261121-english-g09-1.actionItem: Wara prémisse nyen so a fä ape a ye ti si mbeni affirmation asara kua, na sara écrire na anglais mbeni explication ti ndo ti ni so asara so prémisse ayeke ngbele ti bouger.

20261121-english-g09-2.title: Ti kiri sara choix ti restaurant tongana avis mingi aga oko oko
20261121-english-g09-2.summary: Famille ayeke yôro restaurant ti déjeuner kozo ti film (akamata na 3:00 p.m.). Ngoi ti déjeuner ayeke heure oko so akamata na 12:30. Information ti avis aga oko oko.
20261121-english-g09-2.principle: Diko avis ti restaurant na étape na étape, kiri sara jugement ti mo, na gbâ na anglais conditions ti évaluation so mo lingbi ti kpe na ni.
20261121-english-g09-2.example: Wara mot wala nömörö oko so mo bâ ni na kozo fois na partie so.
20261121-english-g09-2.actionItem: Diko avis ti restaurant na étape na étape, kiri sara jugement ti mo, na gbâ na anglais conditions ti évaluation so mo lingbi ti kpe na ni.

20261121-english-g10-1.title: E sû tongana nyen deux avis so ayeke na conflit na journal tî école?
20261121-english-g10-1.summary:
Mo ayeke na équipe éditoriale tî journal anglais tî école. Avis use na ndö tî festival ayeke nde na ôko na ôko.

School notice: "Festival: Friday, 4 p.m., in the gym. Free for all students."
Student council poster: "Festival: Friday, 5 p.m., in the gym. Tickets: 1,000 won."

Mo confirmer ape ngbii so ôko wa ayeke correct.
20261121-english-g10-1.principle: Tongana a confirmer ni ape, ye juste ayeke tî tene ye so sources use ôko ôko atene, na tene na lecteurs so a vérifier ni ngbii. Sï ôko mbage na tene ni, wala tene na azo tî ga ape na information ayeke ape, asara lecteurs aleurrer.
20261121-english-g10-1.example: Sara comparaison tî information so annonce ôko ôko amû na lecteurs na ye so ala vuko.
20261121-english-g10-1.actionItem: Sû tî lecteurs (élèves) mbeni texte so amû deux avis nde nde na lege juste, na tene ye so a confirmer ni ape na ye so lecteurs lingbi tî sara.

20261121-english-g10-2.title: Cas oko alingbi ti fa ndali ti tene 'ngbâ'?
20261121-english-g10-2.summary:
Ni ayeke ndo ti texte so a imprimer na journal ti ecole (nömörö ti ligne akomanse na 1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone.
20261121-english-g10-2.principle: Ligne 3 ayeke kpale. Tene so nömörö ayeke 'tâ' kiri ti 'student kue' na gi nömörö ti student oko so akiri (ligne 2) ayeke conclusion kota ahon preuve. Nömörö so akiri alingbi ti ayeke na ndali ti nde, tongana ngangu ti test wala bê-ti-mo. Ligne 4 amû ndali ti nde na nömörö (bruit, triche), ni la a lingbi ti bâ ni na tele ti ni na problème so. "Banned for everyone" na ligne 5 asi nga na conclusion so, me ndo so problème asi kozo ayeke ligne 3.
20261121-english-g10-2.example: Ti ligne oko oko, fa nde ti 'ye so ni atene' na 'ye so ni asi na conclusion'.
20261121-english-g10-2.actionItem: Na texte ti argument, wara ligne so preuve akpe bâ so nzoni pëpe, gbu sika ni tongana phrase so abâ nzoni mingi, na decide preuve wa a hunda ti sika.

20261121-english-g11-1.title: Instruction ti travail so ayeke clair pëpe: ye wa a lingbi ti hunda kozo?
20261121-english-g11-1.summary:
Ni ayeke email so stagiaire Jiho awara ti chef d'équipe Ms. Han.

Hi Jiho,
Please send the sales summary to the client before the meeting.
Thanks,
Ms. Han

Faits so Jiho ahinga: Calendrier ti équipe afa rencontre na Aurora Co. na mardi na 10:00 na rencontre na Blue Pine Ltd. na jeudi na 14:00. Dossier partagé ayeke na fichiers ti résumé ti ventes ndulu ti juillet, août na septembre.
20261121-english-g11-1.principle: Tongana client na période a zia décision ti ala pëpe, mo lingbi ti zia fichier sioni na client sioni. Ti format, mo lingbi ti zia défaut tongana PDF na ti tene na lo, na so Ms. Han ayeke na travail ayeke na lien pëpe na travail même.
20261121-english-g11-1.example: Vérifier so 'ti zo wa,' 'nyen,' na 'kozo ti ngoi wa' oko oko aga tongana ye oko tâ na email.
20261121-english-g11-1.actionItem: Na email ti travail so ayeke vague, yôro information so a lingbi ti confirmer kozo ti sara, na gbâ email ti question so ayeke ngbele ti kiri réponse na ni.

20261121-english-g11-2.title: Ni ayeke ndali ti club ti lecture? Information nyen alingbi ti mû e lege ti hinga?
20261121-english-g11-2.summary:
Ni ayeke mbeni partie ti rapport ti conseil des élèves.

"Aélèves so asara inscription na club ti lecture ti lekole awara asommes ti test ti anglais so akota ti aélèves so asara inscription ape (moyenne 82 na 74). Ni la club ti lecture akota asommes ti anglais."

Élève Mina aye ti kaï so conclusion so ayeke tâ wala ape. Aélèves asara inscription na club tongana ala aye ni.
20261121-english-g11-2.principle: Tongana mo hinga ascores ti kozo ti inscription, mo lingbi ti kaï so ascores ti amembres ayeke kota déjà wala ala akota pekoni ti inscription. Ndali ti so aélèves asara inscription tongana ala aye ni, aélèves mingi so ayeke nzoni déjà na anglais alingbi ti asara inscription.
20261121-english-g11-2.example: Bâ tongana nyen fait so aélèves asara inscription 'tongana ala aye ni' alingbi ti asara effet na point ti kamata ti agroupes use.
20261121-english-g11-2.actionItem: Sa choix ti information so a ye ti hinga so différence ti ascores ti amembres ti club na ti azo so ayeke membres ape ayeke effet ti club wala ape, na sara écrire na anglais mbeni question ti wara information so.

20261121-english-g12-1.title: Student so amä petit-déjeuner ayeke na nömörö ti ndö: ye wa e lingbi ti hinga nga?
20261121-english-g12-1.summary:
Ni ayeke tënë ti article ti ecole. "Student so amä petit-déjeuner awara nömörö ti test ti ndö, ni la ecole alingbi ti mû petit-déjeuner ti gratuit." Tongana preuve, a fa résultat ti enquête ti student 200 tongana na gbe.

Groupe | Nömörö ti student | Nömörö moyen
Student so amä petit-déjeuner | 130 | 82
Student so akpa petit-déjeuner | 70 | 74
20261121-english-g12-1.principle: b abâ ndali ti nde (sommeil, ntangu ti étude), c abâ résultat ti intervention tâ, na e abâ nzoni ti comparaison. a na d ayeke preuve pëpe so kobe amû nömörö ti ndö.
20261121-english-g12-1.example: Bâ so tënë oko oko asara na kiri tënë ti hunda, 'Lien ti petit-déjeuner na nömörö ayeke ndali?'
20261121-english-g12-1.actionItem: Sara jugement so résultat ti enquête afa e ndali wala pëpe, fa tënë ti sika so a hunda ti jugement so, na fa na anglais lege ti comparaison ti bâ ye so kobe ti gratuit asara.

20261121-english-g12-2.title: Même événement, titres nde nde: jugements achanger tongana information aya
20261121-english-g12-2.summary: Article na ndö tî conseil tî ville so adécider tî ya kâ tî stationnement vuko na gare asi na étapes. Bâ so jugement tî mo achanger tongana information aya.
20261121-english-g12-2.principle: Tongana information aya, réviser jugement tî mo so ton na omissions tî titre aga na ôko mbage tongana a sara comparaison na faits, na fa ôko élément na anglais.
20261121-english-g12-2.example: Sara séparation tî anzo na yâ tî titre so amû faits na ala so amû sentiment.
20261121-english-g12-2.actionItem: Tongana information aya, réviser jugement tî mo so ton na omissions tî titre aga na ôko mbage tongana a sara comparaison na faits, na fa ôko élément na anglais.

20261122-english-g01-1.title: Gi actions so alingbi na pancarte tî piscine ape
20261122-english-g01-1.summary:
Pancarte na entrée tî piscine (a sû ni na anzo gï, image ayeke ape):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = an adult)

Azo 4 ayeke ague na piscine.
Mina ayeke 7. Lo ga na maman tî lo, na lo ayeke na bonnet.
Jun ayeke 10. Lo ga seul, na lo ayeke na bonnet ape.
Tom ayeke 6. Lo ga na frère tî lo. Frère tî lo ayeke 9. Tom ayeke na bonnet.
Sue ayeke 11. Lo ague na pied na piscine seul, na lo ayeke na bonnet.
20261122-english-g01-1.principle: Jun ayeke na bonnet ape, ndali ni lo kpe règle 2. Tom ayeke kêtê ahon 8, me frère so aga na lo ayeke 9, ndali ni lo ayeke 'grown-up' ape, na Tom akpe règle 3. Mina aga na maman tî lo, na Sue ayeke 11, ndali ni ayeke nzoni so lo ague na lo ga seul.
20261122-english-g01-1.example: Sara tableau na âge tî zo ôko ôko, zo wa lo ga na lo, na bonnet, ôko ôko.
20261122-english-g01-1.actionItem: Sara correspondance tî règles ota so ayeke na pancarte na situation tî zo ôko ôko, sï cas so akpe règles, na tene ndali na anglais.

20261122-english-g01-2.title: Réparer ligne so ayeke faux na avis tî objets perdus so a copier
20261122-english-g01-2.summary:
Mbeni avis na tableau tî école (a sû ni na anzo gï):

Lost and Found
Found: a blue water bottle, near Room 3.
Ask Ms. Park in Room 1 after school.

Ami tî mo Jia abâ avis so ndali lo yeke gi bouteille d'eau tî lo, na lo sara message na Hana. Hana aye tî sara comparaison tî ni na avis.
20261122-english-g01-2.principle: Ligne 4 ayeke faux. Na yâ tî avis, Ms. Park ayeke na Room 1, me message atene Room 3, ndali ni ayeke faux. Blue na ligne 2 ayeke même na avis, na Room 3 na ligne 3 ayeke ndo so a wara bouteille, ndali ni ayeke correct.
20261122-english-g01-2.example: Fa anzo na yâ tî avis (couleur, nömörö tî salle, nom tî zo) ôko ôko na sara correspondance tî ala na lignes tî message.
20261122-english-g01-2.actionItem: Sara comparaison tî avis tî objets perdus na message so ami acopier na ni, ligne ôko ôko, gi ligne so ayeke faux, na réécrire ni correctement.

20261122-english-g02-1.title: 'Two tickets, please.' ayeke na ndo wa? Jugement so information alingbi wala pëpe
20261122-english-g02-1.summary:
Mo mä ye so ôko homme na ôko employé tî tickets atene. Ala atene ape so ndo ni ayeke wa.

Man: Two tickets, please.
Clerk: Here you are. The show starts at 7:00.
20261122-english-g02-1.principle: Ticket na show ayeke anzo so a sâra kua na ni na ndo mingi, tongana cinéma wala salle tî concert. Ayeke ngangu tî décider ôko na lignes use gï.
20261122-english-g02-1.example: Pensée na ndo use wala ota so lignes use so alingbi tî tene ni na ni.
20261122-english-g02-1.actionItem: Jugement so mo lingbi tî décider ndo na lignes use so a mä ni gï, na sï indice nouveau so asara séparation tî ndo.

20261122-english-g02-2.title: Réponse wa alingbi na salut tî maître? Pensée na limites tî politesse
20261122-english-g02-2.summary:
Maître atene na ndurû, "How are you today, Mina?"

Ami tî mo Jin atene, "Na anglais, tî tene na politesse ayeke nzoni ngbii kûê. Mo lingbi tî tene tongana so na zo kûê."
20261122-english-g02-2.principle: b na d aréponder na salut na demander nga na zo nde, ndali ni alingbi na maître. a ayeke décontracté mingi na c ayeke rude.
20261122-english-g02-2.example: Vérifier nde nde so réponse alingbi na question na so ayeke alingbi na maître.
20261122-english-g02-2.actionItem: Sï réponse so alingbi na salut tî maître, na fa mbeni cas so tene 'ayeke nzoni tî ayeke poli tî ngbii kûê' alingbi ape.

20261122-english-g03-1.title: Wara ngoi ti diko na programme ti Samedi ti Mina
20261122-english-g03-1.summary:
Programme ti Samedi ti Mina (a gbâ ni na texte gï, image ayeke pëpe):

10 a.m.: I can start my free time.
12 p.m. - 1 p.m.: Lunch
1 p.m. - 2 p.m.: Dance class
5 p.m.: Dinner. I must finish before dinner.

Mina aye ti diko livre ti heure 1. Lo kamata na heure même na asara ni na heure même.
20261122-english-g03-1.principle: Ngoi libre akamata na heure 10 ti matin, na 12 ti 14 ayeke plein na repas ti midi na danse. Activité oko ape ayeke na horaire ti 15 ti 16 na ti 16 ti 17, na ala asï ti ti si na repas ti nuit.
20261122-english-g03-1.example: Sara changement ti ngoi na programme na nombres ti 24 heures na sara bande ti temps.
20261122-english-g03-1.actionItem: Sara ngoi ti kozo ti diko ndulu so alingbi na conditions kue ti programme, na fa ndali ti nyen ngoi ti ambeni asara travail pëpe.

20261122-english-g03-2.title: Fa 'worry' na tene ni ape
20261122-english-g03-2.summary: Mo ye ti sara écrire mbeni scène so ami ti mo Mina ayeke na souci na yâ ti mbeni test. Texte so atene sentiment kâ kâ na texte so afa ni na aactions asï na lecteur na lege mbeni mbeni.
20261122-english-g03-2.principle: Na amains so ayeke froid na ti kaï horloge fois mingi, lecteur alingbi ti sara jeu ti nervosité. Ti bâiller na ti bâ na dehors ti fenêtre amû idée ti ennui, na ti sourire na ti sara écrire na ngoi kete amû idée ti tranquillité wala confiance.
20261122-english-g03-2.example: Na yâ ti chaque ti atextes ota, wara na sara écrire action wala change ti kâ ti Mina.
20261122-english-g03-2.actionItem: Sara mbeni kete texte so lecteur alingbi ti sara jeu ti sentiment gï na aactions na aindices ti kâ, na mot ti sentiment oko ape.

20261122-english-g04-1.title: Note ti Mama na ntangu ti ngia ti Jisu
20261122-english-g04-1.summary:
Note so Mama azia na table (a gbu gi na texte, image ayeke pëpe):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Na pekoni ami ti lo Jisu atomba texte. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"
20261122-english-g04-1.principle: Piano class ayeke 4:00-4:30, ni la 4:15-4:30 akpa na ndö ti ti nde, na kpa trash na 5:00 asi na yâ ti 4:15-5:15. Kiri na ndo na 3:30 na dîner na 6:30 ayeke na gbe ti ntangu ti park.
20261122-english-g04-1.example: Zia ligne oko oko vene na ntangu ti park '4:15-5:15' oko oko, na bâ so ni asi kozo ti ni wala ni akomanse pekoni.
20261122-english-g04-1.actionItem: Sara comparaison ti plan mingi na note ti Mama na ntangu so ami afa, wara ndo so ala alingbi pëpe, na tene ôn-ën na anglais na fa ntangu ti nde.

20261122-english-g04-2.title: Fa ntangu ti promenade ti chien na ti devoir
20261122-english-g04-2.summary:
Note so Papa azia (a gbu gi na texte, image ayeke pëpe):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

Na gbe, gbu ntangu oko oko tongana 'minute mingi tongana nye pekoni ti 4:00 p.m.'. Na exemple, tongana mo komanse na 4:30, gbu 30, na tongana mo komanse na 5:15, gbu 75.
20261122-english-g04-2.principle: Devoir ayeke 5:00-6:00 na promenade ayeke 5:30-6:00, ni la tâche use akpa na ndö ti ti nde ti 5:30 tî 6:00. Promenade akomanse pekoni ti 5:00 na use asi kozo ti 6:30, ni la condition ti nde angbâ.
20261122-english-g04-2.example: Zia ntangu so a sara (na minute) na ntangu ti komanse ti tâche oko oko ti wara ntangu so ni asi.
20261122-english-g04-2.actionItem: Sara combinaison mingi ti nde ti ntangu ti promenade na ntangu ti devoir so asara condition kue ti note ti Papa.

20261122-english-g05-1.title: Pensée ti mo asara changement tongana mo diko affiche
20261122-english-g05-1.summary: Jun ayeke membre ti Green Library pëpe. Ami ti lo Ara ayeke membre ti Green Library. Ala use ayeke diko affiche na ndo ti bibliothèque ligne oko oko.
20261122-english-g05-1.principle: Sara changement ti jugement ti mo ngoi oko oko so information ti affiche a fa ni na étapes, na sara question anglaise so avérifier information so ayeke na affiche pëpe.
20261122-english-g05-1.example: Kaï so phrase so ayeke fini ti ngoi so achange jugement ti kozo ti mo wala ape.
20261122-english-g05-1.actionItem: Sara changement ti jugement ti mo ngoi oko oko so information ti affiche a fa ni na étapes, na sara question anglaise so avérifier information so ayeke na affiche pëpe.

20261122-english-g05-2.title: 'Most popular' - texte asûtenu ni?
20261122-english-g05-2.summary:
Classe ti Mina ayeke na coin ti lecture na étagère ti livres.

Our class has a reading corner. There are 20 books on the shelf. Twelve of them are about animals. Four are about space, and four are story books. The teacher did not buy any new books this year.

Mina atene, "Animal books are the most popular in our class."
20261122-english-g05-2.principle: Texte atene gï nombre ti livres na étagère (livres ti animaux 12, na ambeni). Ni atene pëpe livres wa élèves adiko wala aprêter mingi, ni la e lingbi ti vérifier tënë 'most popular' pëpe.
20261122-english-g05-2.example: Bâ 'popular' afa nyen na tënë ti Mina, na gi phrase na texte so afa ni na mo.
20261122-english-g05-2.actionItem: Bâ so information ti nombres na texte asûtenu tënë (popular) wala pëpe, na sara question anglaise so alingbi ti vérifier tënë.

20261122-english-g06-1.title: Club ti livre ayeke succès? Ndoye jugement ti mo tongana preuve agä mingi
20261122-english-g06-1.summary: Club ti livre ti sika akomanse na ecole ti e. Professeur atene, "Club ayeke succès." Mo yeke wara preuve oko oko na mo yeke bâ na bê ti mo so tënë so ayeke tâ wala pëpe.
20261122-english-g06-1.principle: Tongana a zia data oko oko, ndoye jugement ti mo na ndö ti tënë 'club ti livre ayeke succès', na kobe na anglais na preuve use.
20261122-english-g06-1.example: Tri ye so data so mo na ni sika afa tâ na ye so mo hinga pëpe ngbâ.
20261122-english-g06-1.actionItem: Tongana a zia data oko oko, ndoye jugement ti mo na ndö ti tënë 'club ti livre ayeke succès', na kobe na anglais na preuve use.

20261122-english-g06-2.title: Sara tableaux tî gi cas so claim ayeke vrai
20261122-english-g06-2.summary: 20 élèves na yâ tî classe ôko ôko amû ôko vote tî activité na pekoni tî temps tî snack: football, art, wala musique. A fa votes tongana s (football), a (art), na m (musique).
20261122-english-g06-2.principle: 8 votes ayeke kota ahon art (6) na musique (6), ndali ni ayeke the most, na ayeke kêtê ahon 10 so ayeke moitié tî 20, ndali ni ayeke moitié ape. Ndali ni a ayeke correct.
20261122-english-g06-2.example: Ajouter 8, 6, na 6, gi moitié tî 20 élèves, na sara comparaison.
20261122-english-g06-2.actionItem: Sara tableaux mingi tî votes mo même so claim anglais 'ni awara votes mingi ahon, me ayeke moitié tî classe ape' ayeke vrai.

20261122-english-g07-1.title: Ben ayeke ga na fête? Ti bâ sens ti ahide ti réponses ti lo
20261122-english-g07-1.summary:
Dialogue ti Jisu na Ben (a gbâ ni na texte gï, image ayeke pëpe):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.
20261122-english-g07-1.principle: Match ti soccer ayeke na matin na fête ayeke na 4 p.m., ni la ngoi use asara chevauchement pëpe. Ben atene gï so lo alingbi ti ayeke fatigué, na na nzoroko lo atene lo ayeke vérifier na maman ti lo kozo. Ni la ye ayeke so a zia décision ti ni (ngoi) na ye ayeke so angbâ (permission ti maman ti lo), na ni a zia décision ti ni pëpe awe.
20261122-english-g07-1.example: Divisé tënë ti Ben na morceaux 4: 'soccer game,' 'party time,' 'tired,' na 'mom.'
20261122-english-g07-1.actionItem: Divisé réponses ti Ben na dialogue ligne na ligne, fa ndulu ti ye so a zia décision ti ni na ye so angbâ, na zia jugement na ndulu ti tene 'lo ayeke ga' wala 'lo ayeke ga pëpe'.

20261122-english-g07-2.title: 'That's fine.' afa tâ so ni ayeke nzoni?
20261122-english-g07-2.summary: Sam na Papa atene ti plans ti vendredi. A fa dialogue na morceaux ota. A gbâ ni na texte gï, image ayeke pëpe.
20261122-english-g07-2.principle: Tongana mo diko dialogue kete kete, zia jugement ti sentiments ti yâ ti zo so atene, na kiri sara jugement ti kozo ti mo tongana indice vandâ aga.
20261122-english-g07-2.example: Wara ton wala mot vandâ oko na morceau so.
20261122-english-g07-2.actionItem: Tongana mo diko dialogue kete kete, zia jugement ti sentiments ti yâ ti zo so atene, na kiri sara jugement ti kozo ti mo tongana indice vandâ aga.

20261122-english-g08-1.title: Réécrire claim so ague mingi na bibliothèque asara so scores aya
20261122-english-g08-1.summary: Mbeni écrivain tî blog aye tî sû ye so: 'Library visits make students' scores go up.' E vérifier phrase so na données.
20261122-english-g08-1.principle: Tongana données nouveau a fa ni, décider mbeni lâ so mo lingbi tî ayeke sûr ngbii tongana nyen na ndö tî claim, na réécrire phrase tî lï.
20261122-english-g08-1.example: Na étape ôko ôko, vérifier so information nouveau asoutenir jugement tî kozo wala asara so ni ayeke ngangu ape.
20261122-english-g08-1.actionItem: Tongana données nouveau a fa ni, décider mbeni lâ so mo lingbi tî ayeke sûr ngbii tongana nyen na ndö tî claim, na réécrire phrase tî lï.

20261122-english-g08-2.title: Sara sika ligne so nömörö ayeke sioni na blog ti nettoyage ti plage
20261122-english-g08-2.summary: Student oko na classe oko agbu post so na blog ti ecole. (Ni ayeke gi texte. Ligne oko oko ayeke na nömörö.)
20261122-english-g08-2.principle: Ligne 3 atene so ala abungbi sac 30 na heure ti kozo, na ligne 4 atene so total ayeke sac 18. Total alingbi ti ayeke kete ahon ye so a bungbi na heure ti kozo pëpe. Post so gi alingbi ti fa pëpe so ligne 3 wala ligne 4 ayeke sioni, ni la mo lingbi ti fa oko.
20261122-english-g08-2.example: Bungbi gi ligne so ayeke na nömörö na sara comparaison ti ala.
20261122-english-g08-2.actionItem: Wara phrase use ti nömörö na blog so alingbi pëpe na tele ti ala, na gbu sika ala ti alingbi na tënë so a bâ awe.

20261122-english-g09-1.title: Ye so a fä ape na 'e vo alunch 200 kete'
20261122-english-g09-1.summary:
A zia ni na tableau d'affichage na ndö ti cafétéria ti lekole.

"Na mois so, cafétéria avendre alunches 200 kete ti mois so akiri. Ni la aélèves aimer fini menu ape."
20261122-english-g09-1.principle: Ti ti kiri ti fait so aventes akete na 'ni alingbi na goût ape', aconditions ti ndo ti ni (nömörö ti aélèves, nömörö ti alâ ti lekole, na ti ndo ti ni) alingbi ti ayeke même. Tongana aélèves ayeke kete wala alâ ti lekole ayeke kete, aventes akete même na goût même.
20261122-english-g09-1.example: Kozo sara écrire na langue ti mo même nyen alingbi ti ayeke ngbanga ti "alunches so a vendre akete".
20261122-english-g09-1.actionItem: Wara prémisse nyen so a fä ape a ye ti si mbeni affirmation asara kua, na sara écrire na anglais mbeni explication ti ndo ti ni so asara so prémisse ayeke ngbele ti bouger.

20261122-english-g09-2.title: Ti kiri sara choix ti restaurant tongana avis mingi aga oko oko
20261122-english-g09-2.summary: Famille ayeke yôro restaurant ti déjeuner kozo ti film (akamata na 3:00 p.m.). Ngoi ti déjeuner ayeke heure oko so akamata na 12:30. Information ti avis aga oko oko.
20261122-english-g09-2.principle: Diko avis ti restaurant na étape na étape, kiri sara jugement ti mo, na gbâ na anglais conditions ti évaluation so mo lingbi ti kpe na ni.
20261122-english-g09-2.example: Wara mot wala nömörö oko so mo bâ ni na kozo fois na partie so.
20261122-english-g09-2.actionItem: Diko avis ti restaurant na étape na étape, kiri sara jugement ti mo, na gbâ na anglais conditions ti évaluation so mo lingbi ti kpe na ni.

20261122-english-g10-1.title: E sû tongana nyen deux avis so ayeke na conflit na journal tî école?
20261122-english-g10-1.summary:
Mo ayeke na équipe éditoriale tî journal anglais tî école. Avis use na ndö tî festival ayeke nde na ôko na ôko.

School notice: "Festival: Friday, 4 p.m., in the gym. Free for all students."
Student council poster: "Festival: Friday, 5 p.m., in the gym. Tickets: 1,000 won."

Mo confirmer ape ngbii so ôko wa ayeke correct.
20261122-english-g10-1.principle: Tongana a confirmer ni ape, ye juste ayeke tî tene ye so sources use ôko ôko atene, na tene na lecteurs so a vérifier ni ngbii. Sï ôko mbage na tene ni, wala tene na azo tî ga ape na information ayeke ape, asara lecteurs aleurrer.
20261122-english-g10-1.example: Sara comparaison tî information so annonce ôko ôko amû na lecteurs na ye so ala vuko.
20261122-english-g10-1.actionItem: Sû tî lecteurs (élèves) mbeni texte so amû deux avis nde nde na lege juste, na tene ye so a confirmer ni ape na ye so lecteurs lingbi tî sara.

20261122-english-g10-2.title: Cas oko alingbi ti fa ndali ti tene 'ngbâ'?
20261122-english-g10-2.summary:
Ni ayeke ndo ti texte so a imprimer na journal ti ecole (nömörö ti ligne akomanse na 1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone.
20261122-english-g10-2.principle: Ligne 3 ayeke kpale. Tene so nömörö ayeke 'tâ' kiri ti 'student kue' na gi nömörö ti student oko so akiri (ligne 2) ayeke conclusion kota ahon preuve. Nömörö so akiri alingbi ti ayeke na ndali ti nde, tongana ngangu ti test wala bê-ti-mo. Ligne 4 amû ndali ti nde na nömörö (bruit, triche), ni la a lingbi ti bâ ni na tele ti ni na problème so. "Banned for everyone" na ligne 5 asi nga na conclusion so, me ndo so problème asi kozo ayeke ligne 3.
20261122-english-g10-2.example: Ti ligne oko oko, fa nde ti 'ye so ni atene' na 'ye so ni asi na conclusion'.
20261122-english-g10-2.actionItem: Na texte ti argument, wara ligne so preuve akpe bâ so nzoni pëpe, gbu sika ni tongana phrase so abâ nzoni mingi, na decide preuve wa a hunda ti sika.

20261122-english-g11-1.title: Instruction ti travail so ayeke clair pëpe: ye wa a lingbi ti hunda kozo?
20261122-english-g11-1.summary:
Ni ayeke email so stagiaire Jiho awara ti chef d'équipe Ms. Han.

Hi Jiho,
Please send the sales summary to the client before the meeting.
Thanks,
Ms. Han

Faits so Jiho ahinga: Calendrier ti équipe afa rencontre na Aurora Co. na mardi na 10:00 na rencontre na Blue Pine Ltd. na jeudi na 14:00. Dossier partagé ayeke na fichiers ti résumé ti ventes ndulu ti juillet, août na septembre.
20261122-english-g11-1.principle: Tongana client na période a zia décision ti ala pëpe, mo lingbi ti zia fichier sioni na client sioni. Ti format, mo lingbi ti zia défaut tongana PDF na ti tene na lo, na so Ms. Han ayeke na travail ayeke na lien pëpe na travail même.
20261122-english-g11-1.example: Vérifier so 'ti zo wa,' 'nyen,' na 'kozo ti ngoi wa' oko oko aga tongana ye oko tâ na email.
20261122-english-g11-1.actionItem: Na email ti travail so ayeke vague, yôro information so a lingbi ti confirmer kozo ti sara, na gbâ email ti question so ayeke ngbele ti kiri réponse na ni.

20261122-english-g11-2.title: Ni ayeke ndali ti club ti lecture? Information nyen alingbi ti mû e lege ti hinga?
20261122-english-g11-2.summary:
Ni ayeke mbeni partie ti rapport ti conseil des élèves.

"Aélèves so asara inscription na club ti lecture ti lekole awara asommes ti test ti anglais so akota ti aélèves so asara inscription ape (moyenne 82 na 74). Ni la club ti lecture akota asommes ti anglais."

Élève Mina aye ti kaï so conclusion so ayeke tâ wala ape. Aélèves asara inscription na club tongana ala aye ni.
20261122-english-g11-2.principle: Tongana mo hinga ascores ti kozo ti inscription, mo lingbi ti kaï so ascores ti amembres ayeke kota déjà wala ala akota pekoni ti inscription. Ndali ti so aélèves asara inscription tongana ala aye ni, aélèves mingi so ayeke nzoni déjà na anglais alingbi ti asara inscription.
20261122-english-g11-2.example: Bâ tongana nyen fait so aélèves asara inscription 'tongana ala aye ni' alingbi ti asara effet na point ti kamata ti agroupes use.
20261122-english-g11-2.actionItem: Sa choix ti information so a ye ti hinga so différence ti ascores ti amembres ti club na ti azo so ayeke membres ape ayeke effet ti club wala ape, na sara écrire na anglais mbeni question ti wara information so.

20261122-english-g12-1.title: Student so amä petit-déjeuner ayeke na nömörö ti ndö: ye wa e lingbi ti hinga nga?
20261122-english-g12-1.summary:
Ni ayeke tënë ti article ti ecole. "Student so amä petit-déjeuner awara nömörö ti test ti ndö, ni la ecole alingbi ti mû petit-déjeuner ti gratuit." Tongana preuve, a fa résultat ti enquête ti student 200 tongana na gbe.

Groupe | Nömörö ti student | Nömörö moyen
Student so amä petit-déjeuner | 130 | 82
Student so akpa petit-déjeuner | 70 | 74
20261122-english-g12-1.principle: b abâ ndali ti nde (sommeil, ntangu ti étude), c abâ résultat ti intervention tâ, na e abâ nzoni ti comparaison. a na d ayeke preuve pëpe so kobe amû nömörö ti ndö.
20261122-english-g12-1.example: Bâ so tënë oko oko asara na kiri tënë ti hunda, 'Lien ti petit-déjeuner na nömörö ayeke ndali?'
20261122-english-g12-1.actionItem: Sara jugement so résultat ti enquête afa e ndali wala pëpe, fa tënë ti sika so a hunda ti jugement so, na fa na anglais lege ti comparaison ti bâ ye so kobe ti gratuit asara.

20261122-english-g12-2.title: Même événement, titres nde nde: jugements achanger tongana information aya
20261122-english-g12-2.summary: Article na ndö tî conseil tî ville so adécider tî ya kâ tî stationnement vuko na gare asi na étapes. Bâ so jugement tî mo achanger tongana information aya.
20261122-english-g12-2.principle: Tongana information aya, réviser jugement tî mo so ton na omissions tî titre aga na ôko mbage tongana a sara comparaison na faits, na fa ôko élément na anglais.
20261122-english-g12-2.example: Sara séparation tî anzo na yâ tî titre so amû faits na ala so amû sentiment.
20261122-english-g12-2.actionItem: Tongana information aya, réviser jugement tî mo so ton na omissions tî titre aga na ôko mbage tongana a sara comparaison na faits, na fa ôko élément na anglais.

20261123-english-g01-1.title: Gi actions so alingbi na pancarte tî piscine ape
20261123-english-g01-1.summary:
Pancarte na entrée tî piscine (a sû ni na anzo gï, image ayeke ape):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = an adult)

Azo 4 ayeke ague na piscine.
Mina ayeke 7. Lo ga na maman tî lo, na lo ayeke na bonnet.
Jun ayeke 10. Lo ga seul, na lo ayeke na bonnet ape.
Tom ayeke 6. Lo ga na frère tî lo. Frère tî lo ayeke 9. Tom ayeke na bonnet.
Sue ayeke 11. Lo ague na pied na piscine seul, na lo ayeke na bonnet.
20261123-english-g01-1.principle: Jun ayeke na bonnet ape, ndali ni lo kpe règle 2. Tom ayeke kêtê ahon 8, me frère so aga na lo ayeke 9, ndali ni lo ayeke 'grown-up' ape, na Tom akpe règle 3. Mina aga na maman tî lo, na Sue ayeke 11, ndali ni ayeke nzoni so lo ague na lo ga seul.
20261123-english-g01-1.example: Sara tableau na âge tî zo ôko ôko, zo wa lo ga na lo, na bonnet, ôko ôko.
20261123-english-g01-1.actionItem: Sara correspondance tî règles ota so ayeke na pancarte na situation tî zo ôko ôko, sï cas so akpe règles, na tene ndali na anglais.

20261123-english-g01-2.title: Réparer ligne so ayeke faux na avis tî objets perdus so a copier
20261123-english-g01-2.summary:
Mbeni avis na tableau tî école (a sû ni na anzo gï):

Lost and Found
Found: a blue water bottle, near Room 3.
Ask Ms. Park in Room 1 after school.

Ami tî mo Jia abâ avis so ndali lo yeke gi bouteille d'eau tî lo, na lo sara message na Hana. Hana aye tî sara comparaison tî ni na avis.
20261123-english-g01-2.principle: Ligne 4 ayeke faux. Na yâ tî avis, Ms. Park ayeke na Room 1, me message atene Room 3, ndali ni ayeke faux. Blue na ligne 2 ayeke même na avis, na Room 3 na ligne 3 ayeke ndo so a wara bouteille, ndali ni ayeke correct.
20261123-english-g01-2.example: Fa anzo na yâ tî avis (couleur, nömörö tî salle, nom tî zo) ôko ôko na sara correspondance tî ala na lignes tî message.
20261123-english-g01-2.actionItem: Sara comparaison tî avis tî objets perdus na message so ami acopier na ni, ligne ôko ôko, gi ligne so ayeke faux, na réécrire ni correctement.

20261123-english-g02-1.title: 'Two tickets, please.' ayeke na ndo wa? Jugement so information alingbi wala pëpe
20261123-english-g02-1.summary:
Mo mä ye so ôko homme na ôko employé tî tickets atene. Ala atene ape so ndo ni ayeke wa.

Man: Two tickets, please.
Clerk: Here you are. The show starts at 7:00.
20261123-english-g02-1.principle: Ticket na show ayeke anzo so a sâra kua na ni na ndo mingi, tongana cinéma wala salle tî concert. Ayeke ngangu tî décider ôko na lignes use gï.
20261123-english-g02-1.example: Pensée na ndo use wala ota so lignes use so alingbi tî tene ni na ni.
20261123-english-g02-1.actionItem: Jugement so mo lingbi tî décider ndo na lignes use so a mä ni gï, na sï indice nouveau so asara séparation tî ndo.

20261123-english-g02-2.title: Réponse wa alingbi na salut tî maître? Pensée na limites tî politesse
20261123-english-g02-2.summary:
Maître atene na ndurû, "How are you today, Mina?"

Ami tî mo Jin atene, "Na anglais, tî tene na politesse ayeke nzoni ngbii kûê. Mo lingbi tî tene tongana so na zo kûê."
20261123-english-g02-2.principle: b na d aréponder na salut na demander nga na zo nde, ndali ni alingbi na maître. a ayeke décontracté mingi na c ayeke rude.
20261123-english-g02-2.example: Vérifier nde nde so réponse alingbi na question na so ayeke alingbi na maître.
20261123-english-g02-2.actionItem: Sï réponse so alingbi na salut tî maître, na fa mbeni cas so tene 'ayeke nzoni tî ayeke poli tî ngbii kûê' alingbi ape.

20261123-english-g03-1.title: Wara ngoi ti diko na programme ti Samedi ti Mina
20261123-english-g03-1.summary:
Programme ti Samedi ti Mina (a gbâ ni na texte gï, image ayeke pëpe):

10 a.m.: I can start my free time.
12 p.m. - 1 p.m.: Lunch
1 p.m. - 2 p.m.: Dance class
5 p.m.: Dinner. I must finish before dinner.

Mina aye ti diko livre ti heure 1. Lo kamata na heure même na asara ni na heure même.
20261123-english-g03-1.principle: Ngoi libre akamata na heure 10 ti matin, na 12 ti 14 ayeke plein na repas ti midi na danse. Activité oko ape ayeke na horaire ti 15 ti 16 na ti 16 ti 17, na ala asï ti ti si na repas ti nuit.
20261123-english-g03-1.example: Sara changement ti ngoi na programme na nombres ti 24 heures na sara bande ti temps.
20261123-english-g03-1.actionItem: Sara ngoi ti kozo ti diko ndulu so alingbi na conditions kue ti programme, na fa ndali ti nyen ngoi ti ambeni asara travail pëpe.

20261123-english-g03-2.title: Fa 'worry' na tene ni ape
20261123-english-g03-2.summary: Mo ye ti sara écrire mbeni scène so ami ti mo Mina ayeke na souci na yâ ti mbeni test. Texte so atene sentiment kâ kâ na texte so afa ni na aactions asï na lecteur na lege mbeni mbeni.
20261123-english-g03-2.principle: Na amains so ayeke froid na ti kaï horloge fois mingi, lecteur alingbi ti sara jeu ti nervosité. Ti bâiller na ti bâ na dehors ti fenêtre amû idée ti ennui, na ti sourire na ti sara écrire na ngoi kete amû idée ti tranquillité wala confiance.
20261123-english-g03-2.example: Na yâ ti chaque ti atextes ota, wara na sara écrire action wala change ti kâ ti Mina.
20261123-english-g03-2.actionItem: Sara mbeni kete texte so lecteur alingbi ti sara jeu ti sentiment gï na aactions na aindices ti kâ, na mot ti sentiment oko ape.

20261123-english-g04-1.title: Note ti Mama na ntangu ti ngia ti Jisu
20261123-english-g04-1.summary:
Note so Mama azia na table (a gbu gi na texte, image ayeke pëpe):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Na pekoni ami ti lo Jisu atomba texte. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"
20261123-english-g04-1.principle: Piano class ayeke 4:00-4:30, ni la 4:15-4:30 akpa na ndö ti ti nde, na kpa trash na 5:00 asi na yâ ti 4:15-5:15. Kiri na ndo na 3:30 na dîner na 6:30 ayeke na gbe ti ntangu ti park.
20261123-english-g04-1.example: Zia ligne oko oko vene na ntangu ti park '4:15-5:15' oko oko, na bâ so ni asi kozo ti ni wala ni akomanse pekoni.
20261123-english-g04-1.actionItem: Sara comparaison ti plan mingi na note ti Mama na ntangu so ami afa, wara ndo so ala alingbi pëpe, na tene ôn-ën na anglais na fa ntangu ti nde.

20261123-english-g04-2.title: Fa ntangu ti promenade ti chien na ti devoir
20261123-english-g04-2.summary:
Note so Papa azia (a gbu gi na texte, image ayeke pëpe):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

Na gbe, gbu ntangu oko oko tongana 'minute mingi tongana nye pekoni ti 4:00 p.m.'. Na exemple, tongana mo komanse na 4:30, gbu 30, na tongana mo komanse na 5:15, gbu 75.
20261123-english-g04-2.principle: Devoir ayeke 5:00-6:00 na promenade ayeke 5:30-6:00, ni la tâche use akpa na ndö ti ti nde ti 5:30 tî 6:00. Promenade akomanse pekoni ti 5:00 na use asi kozo ti 6:30, ni la condition ti nde angbâ.
20261123-english-g04-2.example: Zia ntangu so a sara (na minute) na ntangu ti komanse ti tâche oko oko ti wara ntangu so ni asi.
20261123-english-g04-2.actionItem: Sara combinaison mingi ti nde ti ntangu ti promenade na ntangu ti devoir so asara condition kue ti note ti Papa.

20261123-english-g05-1.title: Pensée ti mo asara changement tongana mo diko affiche
20261123-english-g05-1.summary: Jun ayeke membre ti Green Library pëpe. Ami ti lo Ara ayeke membre ti Green Library. Ala use ayeke diko affiche na ndo ti bibliothèque ligne oko oko.
20261123-english-g05-1.principle: Sara changement ti jugement ti mo ngoi oko oko so information ti affiche a fa ni na étapes, na sara question anglaise so avérifier information so ayeke na affiche pëpe.
20261123-english-g05-1.example: Kaï so phrase so ayeke fini ti ngoi so achange jugement ti kozo ti mo wala ape.
20261123-english-g05-1.actionItem: Sara changement ti jugement ti mo ngoi oko oko so information ti affiche a fa ni na étapes, na sara question anglaise so avérifier information so ayeke na affiche pëpe.

20261123-english-g05-2.title: 'Most popular' - texte asûtenu ni?
20261123-english-g05-2.summary:
Classe ti Mina ayeke na coin ti lecture na étagère ti livres.

Our class has a reading corner. There are 20 books on the shelf. Twelve of them are about animals. Four are about space, and four are story books. The teacher did not buy any new books this year.

Mina atene, "Animal books are the most popular in our class."
20261123-english-g05-2.principle: Texte atene gï nombre ti livres na étagère (livres ti animaux 12, na ambeni). Ni atene pëpe livres wa élèves adiko wala aprêter mingi, ni la e lingbi ti vérifier tënë 'most popular' pëpe.
20261123-english-g05-2.example: Bâ 'popular' afa nyen na tënë ti Mina, na gi phrase na texte so afa ni na mo.
20261123-english-g05-2.actionItem: Bâ so information ti nombres na texte asûtenu tënë (popular) wala pëpe, na sara question anglaise so alingbi ti vérifier tënë.

20261123-english-g06-1.title: Club ti livre ayeke succès? Ndoye jugement ti mo tongana preuve agä mingi
20261123-english-g06-1.summary: Club ti livre ti sika akomanse na ecole ti e. Professeur atene, "Club ayeke succès." Mo yeke wara preuve oko oko na mo yeke bâ na bê ti mo so tënë so ayeke tâ wala pëpe.
20261123-english-g06-1.principle: Tongana a zia data oko oko, ndoye jugement ti mo na ndö ti tënë 'club ti livre ayeke succès', na kobe na anglais na preuve use.
20261123-english-g06-1.example: Tri ye so data so mo na ni sika afa tâ na ye so mo hinga pëpe ngbâ.
20261123-english-g06-1.actionItem: Tongana a zia data oko oko, ndoye jugement ti mo na ndö ti tënë 'club ti livre ayeke succès', na kobe na anglais na preuve use.

20261123-english-g06-2.title: Sara tableaux tî gi cas so claim ayeke vrai
20261123-english-g06-2.summary: 20 élèves na yâ tî classe ôko ôko amû ôko vote tî activité na pekoni tî temps tî snack: football, art, wala musique. A fa votes tongana s (football), a (art), na m (musique).
20261123-english-g06-2.principle: 8 votes ayeke kota ahon art (6) na musique (6), ndali ni ayeke the most, na ayeke kêtê ahon 10 so ayeke moitié tî 20, ndali ni ayeke moitié ape. Ndali ni a ayeke correct.
20261123-english-g06-2.example: Ajouter 8, 6, na 6, gi moitié tî 20 élèves, na sara comparaison.
20261123-english-g06-2.actionItem: Sara tableaux mingi tî votes mo même so claim anglais 'ni awara votes mingi ahon, me ayeke moitié tî classe ape' ayeke vrai.

20261123-english-g07-1.title: Ben ayeke ga na fête? Ti bâ sens ti ahide ti réponses ti lo
20261123-english-g07-1.summary:
Dialogue ti Jisu na Ben (a gbâ ni na texte gï, image ayeke pëpe):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.
20261123-english-g07-1.principle: Match ti soccer ayeke na matin na fête ayeke na 4 p.m., ni la ngoi use asara chevauchement pëpe. Ben atene gï so lo alingbi ti ayeke fatigué, na na nzoroko lo atene lo ayeke vérifier na maman ti lo kozo. Ni la ye ayeke so a zia décision ti ni (ngoi) na ye ayeke so angbâ (permission ti maman ti lo), na ni a zia décision ti ni pëpe awe.
20261123-english-g07-1.example: Divisé tënë ti Ben na morceaux 4: 'soccer game,' 'party time,' 'tired,' na 'mom.'
20261123-english-g07-1.actionItem: Divisé réponses ti Ben na dialogue ligne na ligne, fa ndulu ti ye so a zia décision ti ni na ye so angbâ, na zia jugement na ndulu ti tene 'lo ayeke ga' wala 'lo ayeke ga pëpe'.

20261123-english-g07-2.title: 'That's fine.' afa tâ so ni ayeke nzoni?
20261123-english-g07-2.summary: Sam na Papa atene ti plans ti vendredi. A fa dialogue na morceaux ota. A gbâ ni na texte gï, image ayeke pëpe.
20261123-english-g07-2.principle: Tongana mo diko dialogue kete kete, zia jugement ti sentiments ti yâ ti zo so atene, na kiri sara jugement ti kozo ti mo tongana indice vandâ aga.
20261123-english-g07-2.example: Wara ton wala mot vandâ oko na morceau so.
20261123-english-g07-2.actionItem: Tongana mo diko dialogue kete kete, zia jugement ti sentiments ti yâ ti zo so atene, na kiri sara jugement ti kozo ti mo tongana indice vandâ aga.

20261123-english-g08-1.title: Réécrire claim so ague mingi na bibliothèque asara so scores aya
20261123-english-g08-1.summary: Mbeni écrivain tî blog aye tî sû ye so: 'Library visits make students' scores go up.' E vérifier phrase so na données.
20261123-english-g08-1.principle: Tongana données nouveau a fa ni, décider mbeni lâ so mo lingbi tî ayeke sûr ngbii tongana nyen na ndö tî claim, na réécrire phrase tî lï.
20261123-english-g08-1.example: Na étape ôko ôko, vérifier so information nouveau asoutenir jugement tî kozo wala asara so ni ayeke ngangu ape.
20261123-english-g08-1.actionItem: Tongana données nouveau a fa ni, décider mbeni lâ so mo lingbi tî ayeke sûr ngbii tongana nyen na ndö tî claim, na réécrire phrase tî lï.

20261123-english-g08-2.title: Sara sika ligne so nömörö ayeke sioni na blog ti nettoyage ti plage
20261123-english-g08-2.summary: Student oko na classe oko agbu post so na blog ti ecole. (Ni ayeke gi texte. Ligne oko oko ayeke na nömörö.)
20261123-english-g08-2.principle: Ligne 3 atene so ala abungbi sac 30 na heure ti kozo, na ligne 4 atene so total ayeke sac 18. Total alingbi ti ayeke kete ahon ye so a bungbi na heure ti kozo pëpe. Post so gi alingbi ti fa pëpe so ligne 3 wala ligne 4 ayeke sioni, ni la mo lingbi ti fa oko.
20261123-english-g08-2.example: Bungbi gi ligne so ayeke na nömörö na sara comparaison ti ala.
20261123-english-g08-2.actionItem: Wara phrase use ti nömörö na blog so alingbi pëpe na tele ti ala, na gbu sika ala ti alingbi na tënë so a bâ awe.

20261123-english-g09-1.title: Ye so a fä ape na 'e vo alunch 200 kete'
20261123-english-g09-1.summary:
A zia ni na tableau d'affichage na ndö ti cafétéria ti lekole.

"Na mois so, cafétéria avendre alunches 200 kete ti mois so akiri. Ni la aélèves aimer fini menu ape."
20261123-english-g09-1.principle: Ti ti kiri ti fait so aventes akete na 'ni alingbi na goût ape', aconditions ti ndo ti ni (nömörö ti aélèves, nömörö ti alâ ti lekole, na ti ndo ti ni) alingbi ti ayeke même. Tongana aélèves ayeke kete wala alâ ti lekole ayeke kete, aventes akete même na goût même.
20261123-english-g09-1.example: Kozo sara écrire na langue ti mo même nyen alingbi ti ayeke ngbanga ti "alunches so a vendre akete".
20261123-english-g09-1.actionItem: Wara prémisse nyen so a fä ape a ye ti si mbeni affirmation asara kua, na sara écrire na anglais mbeni explication ti ndo ti ni so asara so prémisse ayeke ngbele ti bouger.

20261123-english-g09-2.title: Ti kiri sara choix ti restaurant tongana avis mingi aga oko oko
20261123-english-g09-2.summary: Famille ayeke yôro restaurant ti déjeuner kozo ti film (akamata na 3:00 p.m.). Ngoi ti déjeuner ayeke heure oko so akamata na 12:30. Information ti avis aga oko oko.
20261123-english-g09-2.principle: Diko avis ti restaurant na étape na étape, kiri sara jugement ti mo, na gbâ na anglais conditions ti évaluation so mo lingbi ti kpe na ni.
20261123-english-g09-2.example: Wara mot wala nömörö oko so mo bâ ni na kozo fois na partie so.
